- Frontmatter: `type: DossierDocument`; `id` such as DOS-SRS; `title`;
       `version` for versioned dossier documents; it is not required for
       `records-of-processing`.
       `document_kind` is srs|architecture|trace-matrix|rmm|verification-report|
       soup|anomalies|risk-management|risk-management-plan|release-record|
       records-of-processing; `generated_by` is `quoin dossier`; `as_of` is an
       RFC 3339 instant (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z), required for rmm;
       a source-backed soup list supplies it, while a soup gap document may omit it.
     - The body is free Markdown. By convention it ends with a level-2 `Gaps`
       heading listing one bullet per missing input, or `Gaps: none`.
     -->
# Software Requirements Specification

## Gaps

Gaps: none
